01: Saying Bismillah before food is just a tradition... right?
03: A boy was eating with the Prophet, peace be upon him... and his hand was going all around the dish.
04: The Prophet, peace be upon him, told him: O boy! Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearest to you.
05: Bismillah. Right hand... and from my side.
